lend.share_said:
lend doc (port 36019) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 36019 --limit <number>`.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare doc` stops lending it.
If doc takes a password on each request, paste what it takes in its Authorization header, then press Enter (Enter alone for none):
